bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money to 8218 Truce Center for worker training.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. 8218 TRUCE CENTER; APPROPRIATION.

$350,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $350,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to 8218 Truce Center, a nonprofit, to train local workers. Grant money may be used for training and support services, programming, administrative support, capacity building, technical assistance, job readiness, and placement. Of this amount, up to ten percent may be used by 8218 Truce Center for administrative costs. This appropriation is onetime and available until June 30, 2027.
